title: MorphologyTab
description: Scriba-style morphology tab: lemma metadata and alternative forms from Lewis & Short (not generated paradigms).

title_orthography.description: Display orthography when it differs from headword.

title_genitive.description: Genitive ending or full genitive form from the dictionary headword line.

gender.description: Gender code from Lewis & Short (e.g. M, F, N).

alternative_genative.description: Spelling matches the source JSON field name (alternative_genative).

lemma_line.description: Dictionary lemma line (main_notes header: principal parts, etc.).
